snippet.title: Half-Life Legacy Steam Release Date Trailer | Half-Life: The Legacy Collection
snippet.description:
Steam Workshop. Achievements. Stats. Bug fixes. New features. Visual enhancements. All coming as a FREE mod to 1998's game of the year. This is Half-Life Legacy - Episode One of the Legacy Collection.

Find out more on the Steam Store Page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3619040

and join our Discord for Community Events and more! - https://discord.gg/mGr94ZqDWU
